outcome: time from induction of labor to vaginal delivery
rate of other induction methods needed
labor augmentation with oxytocin and/or amniotomy
cohort: Nulliparous women at term with Bishop score <6
finding: Misoprostol vaginal insert proved to shorten the time to vaginal delivery and to reduce the use of other methods of labor induction and augmentation, but it did not reduce the cesarean section rate compared with oral misoprostol.
mod_finding: While misoprostol vaginal insert did not reduce the cesarean section rate compared to oral misoprostol, it did shorten the time to vaginal delivery.
